importOptions.teachingGrid: Quarter-note pulses at the MIDI tempo; four-pulse count-in. Source has no meter event.

arrangement.title: Two-hand live melody
arrangement.provenance: All 159 notes from MIDI ce00474f06ea7e4b5af71ae009ca99c12fe8d1ef368d9a06b73dcd7924620f46; no automatic backing.
decisions: Every source attack and key release is retained, including the opening rest and all two-note overlaps. No transposition, quantization, merging or trimming.
One shared Honk per distinct pitch, reused for every repeated note. Two-hand assignments preserve independent overlapping holds; either hand can play each target. Highlighting uses plain squares.
No Looper instruments, Looper tracks, or automatic accompaniment. The Metronome supplies timing only.
Source piano timbre is replaced by the normal Honk voice. MIDI velocity remains provenance; normal Trigger dynamics apply.
Quarter-note pulses at the MIDI tempo; four-pulse count-in. Source has no meter event.

recording.instructions: Play every melody note live with both hands. Aim at the Honk with the highlighted square and hold Trigger to play; the gray circle marks the next note. Release Trigger before pressing again for the next note. This song has no Looper or backing track.
